items.q: I did, oh, a few things for Duke

ctx.x: Duke Dailey Daly. There's a guy that was a happy go lucky fellow. I did, oh, a few things for Duke, and he was quite a character; however, a sad thing happened. He
just disappeared one day, and nobody's heard of Duke Dailey since, and he was a guy that flew.
